v1Client.note: Offering descriptors publish compatibility.morphirCli "<0.0.0-0", which no version satisfies, so the Morphir CLI's tool release metadata v1 client never selects a .NET host offering, at referenceClient.cliVersion or any other version. Each selection runs that client by tool id, channel and v1 platform and expects nothing selected; the fsharp-builtin recipe still binds recipeBinding.targetPath for that deployment and platform with its authenticated digest, and the 18 digests are distinct. The controls run the same client on morphir-v1-control 1.2.3, a release that is not an offering, whose compatibility.morphirCli is ">=0.4.0-0, <0.5.0": it is selected at 0.4.0, 0.4.0-beta.12 and 0.4.9, and not at 0.3.9, 0.5.0 or 0.5.0-alpha.1, which is below 0.5.0 but a prerelease of another version. So a client that never selects fails them. The version 1 resolver's own corpus is docs/spec/tool-release-metadata/fixtures/v1/conformance.json.

v1Descriptors.note: Each listed release target, read through the TUF client, is an unchanged tool release metadata v1 descriptor: it validates against tool-release-v1.schema.json, has schemaVersion 1, and its target's custom.morphir kind is tool-release. The release targets not listed are the deliberate negatives that the host binding rows refuse: releases/morphir-dotnet-not-a-release, -unknown-status, -other-tool-id, -other-version and -cli-range, each at 1.2.3.
